text_markup: {card:Gebrselassie}'s static ability replaces the durations of certain lingering effects affecting its host with a duration of "for the remainder of the turn." If {card:Gebrselassie} is uninstalled or moved to a different host, its replacement effect no longer applies to those lingering effects, so they revert to their normal durations. If any of those durations have already expired, the corresponding effects will end at the next checkpoint.
